summary: Device self-inspection → unified NodeCapabilityReport; per-probe isolation (no probe failure crashes the node)
implementation: electron/tenx/device-inspector.ts: inspectDeviceV10 — probes cpu/memory/gpu/storage/runtime/network/providers/proxy; every probe wrapped by probeIsolated (throw ⇒ FAILED verdict, report still produced); observed-facts-only (no probe can fabricate READY); injectable facts + per-probe overrides for deterministic tests; JSON-serializable NodeCapabilityReport output
Uses the Phase 10A/10C contract types from src/shared/tenx (NodeCapabilityReport/ProbeVerdict/NodeIdentity).
tests: tests/unit/tenx-phase-10c.test.ts (5 tests): AVAILABLE report when all probes observe facts; honest DEGRADED when network/provider unobserved (OFFLINE effective); throwing gpu+network probes isolated (FAILED verdicts, unrelated cpu/memory stay READY, report produced, no crash); JSON round-trip; empty gpu/storage ⇒ UNKNOWN not fabricated READY
notes: Phase 10C requirement 'cannot crash on capability probe failure' proven by throwing-probe test.
